mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% over a one-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by >0.1pp in one month, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates weakening demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a joint regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 103.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in real economic output, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO remains below 103.0 for two months, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 1.0% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, the market expects prolonged accommodative policy, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both FEDFUNDS < 1.0 and CPIAUCSL > 3.0, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payrolls below 150,000 thousand in a single month signals a labor market collapse, which triggers equity sell-offs due to recession fears and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS < 150000, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in residential construction starts above 1600 thousand units after two consecutive months of decline signals a recovery in housing demand, which boosts confidence in the broader economy and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST rebounds above 1600 after two declines, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous contraction in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and a decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a broad-based demand collapse, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS and GDPC1 decline, or the joint interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.
